dimensions.assessment: Affects state child welfare agencies, foster and adoptive parents, kinship providers, and children in foster care nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: requires state plans for child welfare services to provide for the development and implementation of a family partnership plan

dimensions.assessment: Modifies state planning requirements and data collection for foster care placement and recruitment.
dimensions.evidence: improve foster care placement stability, increase rates of kinship placements, and align the composition of foster and adoptive families

dimensions.assessment: Involves state reporting and federal outcome reports, but specifies no dollar amounts.
Amends parts B and E of title IV of the Social Security Act to add mandatory state plan requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend parts B and E of title IV of the Social Security Act to improve foster and adoptive parent recruitment and retention

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory planning and annual reporting requirements for state child welfare programs.

missing_information: Federal or state funding allocations required to implement the plans
importance_detail.rationale: Requires state child welfare plans to implement family partnership plans and mandates annual reporting on foster and adoptive family recruitment and retention.
